{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgDAvZcy8roSSfhbsLSmb","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01UgYUNg8b33djvcXxN7XFC5","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cd /app; python -c \"\nimport pandas as pd, numpy as np\nfrom scipy.stats import chi2\ndf=pd.read_csv('dataset/synthetic_stroke_data.csv')\nnoise=(~df.avg_glucose_level.between(20,800))|(~df.bmi.between(10,60))|(df.age>120)|(df.age<0)\nd=df[~noise].copy()\nnum=['age','bmi','avg_glucose_level']\nd['risk_proxy']=np.prod([d[c]/d[c].max() for c in num],axis=0)\nfor cols in [num+['risk_proxy'], num]:\n    X=d[cols].values; mu=X.mean(0); S=np.cov(X,rowvar=False)\n    diff=X-mu; md=np.einsum('ij,jk,ik->i',diff,np.linalg.inv(S),diff)\n    crit=chi2.ppf(0.99,len(cols))\n    out=d.index[md>crit]\n    print(cols, crit, len(out), list(out))\n    dd=d.drop(out)\n    ch=dd.age<=14; td=dd.age<=3\n    c1=dd.index[ch & dd.smoking_status.isin(['smokes','formerly smoked'])]\n    c2=dd.index[ch & dd.work_type.isin(['Private','Self-employed','Govt_job'])]\n    c3=dd.index[td & (dd.work_type=='student')]\n    print(list(c1),list(c2),list(c3))\n\"","description":"Compute Mahalanobis and categorical outliers"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":607,"cache_read_input_tokens":29404,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":607,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"c2ca2169-b90e-44ce-bdb3-73ba2ec7dfaa","uuid":"84894770-93a2-4fc8-9979-6f9356b745a4","timestamp":"2026-10-20T08:27:25.786Z"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgDAzBdExT7JG8AkzWdAb","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01KWSkMRPmZJcjaAd8NzMMNt","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"mkdir -p /tmp/work && cat > /app/answer.py <<'EOF'\nimport numpy as np\nimport pandas as pd\nfrom scipy.stats import chi2\n\nDATA_PATH = \"/app/dataset/synthetic_stroke_data.csv\"\nNUM_COLS = [\"age\", \"bmi\", \"avg_glucose_level\"]\n\n\ndef iqr_mask(s: pd.Series, k: float = 3.0) -> pd.Series:\n    q1, q3 = s.quantile([0.25, 0.75])\n    iqr = q3 - q1\n    return (s < q1 - k * iqr) | (s > q3 + k * iqr)\n\n\ndef answer() -> list[int]:\n    original = pd.read_csv(DATA_PATH)\n    df = original.copy()\n    id_col = \"patient_id\"\n    id_to_index = pd.Series(original.index, index=original[id_col])\n\n    # 1. Technical noise: physically impossible values\n    noise = (\n        ~df[\"avg_glucose_level\"].between(20, 800)\n        | ~df[\"bmi\"].between(10, 60)\n        | (df[\"age\"] > 120)\n        | (df[\"age\"] < 0)\n    )\n    noise_ids = df.loc[noise, id_col].tolist()\n    df = df.loc[~noise].reset_index(drop=True)\n\n    # 2. Standard outliers (3*IQR), with the stroke rule for avg_glucose_level\n    iqr_ids = []\n    for col in [\"age\", \"bmi\"]:\n        iqr_ids += df.loc[iqr_mask(df[col]), id_col].tolist()\n\n    glucose_out = iqr_mask(df[\"avg_glucose_level\"])\n    if glucose_out.any():\n        stroke_share = df.loc[glucose_out, \"stroke\"].mean()\n        if stroke_share >= 0.5:\n            glucose_out[:] = False\n        elif stroke_share > 0.2:\n            df[\"avg_glucose_level\"] = np.log2(df[\"avg_glucose_level\"])\n            glucose_out = iqr_mask(df[\"avg_glucose_level\"])\n            if glucose_out.any() and df.loc[glucose_out, \"stroke\"].mean() >= 0.5:\n                glucose_out[:] = False\n    iqr_ids += df.loc[glucose_out, id_col].tolist()\n    iqr_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(iqr_ids))\n    df = df.loc[~df[id_col].isin(iqr_ids)].reset_index(drop=True)\n\n    # 3. Risk proxy: product of max-normalized numerical features\n    df[\"risk_proxy\"] = np.prod([df[c] / df[c].max() for c in NUM_COLS], axis=0)\n\n    # 4. Multivariate outliers: squared Mahalanobis distance vs chi-square critical value\n    maha_cols = NUM_COLS + [\"risk_proxy\"]\n    X = df[maha_cols].to_numpy(dtype=float)\n    diff = X - X.mean(axis=0)\n    inv_cov = np.linalg.pinv(np.cov(X, rowvar=False))\n    d2 = np.einsum(\"ij,jk,ik->i\", diff, inv_cov, diff)\n    critical = chi2.ppf(1 - 0.01, df=len(maha_cols))\n    maha_ids = df.loc[d2 > critical, id_col].tolist()\n    df = df.loc[~df[id_col].isin(maha_ids)].reset_index(drop=True)\n\n    # 5. Implausible categorical combinations\n    children = df[\"age\"] <= 14\n    toddlers = df[\"age\"] <= 3\n    smoking_child = children & df[\"smoking_status\"].isin([\"smokes\", \"formerly smoked\"])\n    working_child = children & df[\"work_type\"].isin([\"Private\", \"Self-employed\", \"Govt_job\"])\n    student_toddler = toddlers & (df[\"work_type\"] == \"student\")\n    cat_ids = df.loc[smoking_child | working_child | student_toddler, id_col].tolist()\n\n    all_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(noise_ids + iqr_ids + maha_ids + cat_ids))\n    return [int(id_to_index[i]) for i in all_ids]\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    import json\n    with open(\"/app/answer.json\", \"w\") as f:\n        json.dump(answer(), f, default=list)\nEOF\ncd /tmp/work && python /app/answer.py && python -c \"\nimport json; a=json.load(open('/app/answer.json')); print(len(a), len(set(a)), a[:10], a[-15:])\n\"","description":"Write answer script and run it"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":971,"cache_read_input_tokens":31619,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":971,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"c2ca2169-b90e-44ce-bdb3-73ba2ec7dfaa","uuid":"895eb54e-ae94-4450-9e68-f56376df903e","timestamp":"2026-10-20T08:28:57.637Z"}
